name: PgBouncer
summary: TCP 6432 across a pool of PgBouncers.
notes: A plain connection check: PgBouncer keeps its own watch on the PostgreSQL servers behind it. With more than one PgBouncer a cancel request can arrive at a different one from the query it is meant for; PgBouncer's peering ([peers] and peer_id) is what passes it on.
